subject.title: fix: prioritize exhausted Antigravity quota in menu bar and highest usage

question: Should automatic Antigravity selection use nearest-actionable-reset semantics in the menu bar while highest-usage ranking uses the maximum-used quota lane, even when the displayed percentage differs from the lane that won ranking?
rationale: The base regression test codifies skip-exhausted behavior, and this PR deliberately replaces it with two consumer-specific interpretations; source correctness alone cannot determine the desired user-facing contract.

options.title: Approve split semantics
options.body: Keep reset-focused menu-bar selection and maximum-usage ranking as distinct documented consumers, with direct proof for both.

options.title: Use one shared lane
options.body: Resolve and display the same most-constrained quota lane everywhere to avoid ranked-versus-shown divergence.

options.title: Preserve current behavior
options.body: Retain skip-exhausted automatic selection if exhausted lanes should remain hidden while usable capacity exists.

recommendation.title: Approve split semantics
recommendation.body: Keep reset-focused menu-bar selection and maximum-usage ranking as distinct documented consumers, with direct proof for both.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged and refined the current Antigravity quota-window behavior and are the strongest available owner for this product contract.
